notes.title: Data Jammers: FastForward now available for Mac OS X!
notes.content:
Despite the (futile) efforts of the NSA to cover it up, Data Jammers: FastForward is now jamming on the Mac! Yep, it's true! Thanks to Henry K's efforts beyond the call of duty, Jammers is finally available for Mac gamers via Steam (with other groovy game portals to follow - watch the skies). So let's get jammin'! 

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/110500/]Get Data Jammers: FastForward on Steam[/url]

Data Jammers: FastForward is a continuously moving three dimensional driving and destruction game set within a retro wireframe world of impossible race tracks. Prowl twisting bitstreams amidst bizarre geometrical environments enhanced by otherworldly soundscapes as your nimble avatar encounters more dangerous denizens, hazards and boss guardians along the way!

notes.title: Indie Royale Bundle Defends Some Dungeons
notes.content:
Rather good fantasy multiplayer tower defence thing, Dungeon Defenders (Wot I Think), is at the heart of the May Indie Royale bundle. The minimum at the time of writing is £3.26, and for that you get Dungeon Defenders, Containment: The Zombie Puzzler, Data Jammers: FastForward, Brainpipe – A Plunge to Unhumanity, and Weird Worlds: Return to Infinite Space. Paying over $7 worth of cash gets you the musical bonus of this chiptune album.

Right. That’s all the bundle news for now. Unless anyone wants to launch one by surprise in the next few minutes? No? Another cup of tea then, I think.

notes.title: Data Jammers: FastForward Updated
notes.content:
Change list:
- added a difficulty level selection to make the game more approachable to new players
- added a way to track your achievement progress during the game
- added an option to restart the current level
- fixed mouse cursor not disappearing during the game
- fixed spacebar not working correctly in the keyboard setup
- fixed "how to play" not displaying 1000-point bonus for getting all the rings

notes.title: Data Jammers: Fast Forward Updated
notes.content:
Change list:
- fixed broken high score list in the demo version - it was still sometimes trying to load a steamworks leaderboard
- fixed long joystick/controller names crashing the configuration screen
- turned down the music volume in the pause screen
